The run stopped at a harness-only visibility requirement for an offscreen Next Page control: background WM_MOUSEWHEEL did not move the viewport. MSAA had already enumerated that control. The later source stage invoked the same owned MSAA control directly and verified paging; no product failure or external-window input occurred.

staged_raw_reports.scope: One successful actual source CRUD/paging/enabled check is preserved. The single-source measurement also completed 1/1 with a correct unavailable/HTTP404 result, as recorded in failure_owned_elements and single_measurement.png. The run then stopped at a harness selector that expected an unchanged hint name after filling an unlabeled TextField. A following short stage resumed only this isolated test data with an empty query and verified all-source progress/cancel and removal, without rerunning prior successful checks.

report.scope: Eight actual Windows checks selected from three same-SHA staged runs (4+1+3), using only the owned app MSAA / HWND message interfaces while another application remained foreground. This is not a claim of one uninterrupted run. No activation attempt, global pointer/keyboard input, external-app content read or external-window capture occurred.
